about.title: Built on the court,defined by character.
about.sub: ACEIT Spikers brings together players who train hard, compete fair, and show up for one another — on and off the court.
about.mission: To build a competitive volleyball program that develops skilled, disciplined athletes while creating a home for anyone who wants to play, grow, and belong.
about.vision: To be recognised as the standard-bearer for collegiate volleyball at ACEIT — a club that wins with class and trains the next generation of captains.

dunkers.title:
Every possession counts,
every basket earned.
dunkers.sub: ACEIT Dunkers squad trains with relentless pace, sharpshooting accuracy, and lockdown team defense.
dunkers.mission: To develop high-IQ, fast-paced basketball players who execute under pressure with unity, grit, and passion.
dunkers.vision: To build an elite championship-winning basketball legacy representing Arya College across national tourneys.

shuttlers.title:
Master every rally,
smash every limit.
shuttlers.sub: ACEIT Shuttlers brings together dedicated singles and doubles shuttlers competing for collegiate and university glory.
shuttlers.mission: To refine reflex speed, court agility, and mental composure in high-stakes collegiate badminton tournaments.
shuttlers.vision: To nurture collegiate badminton champions who dominate inter-university championships with skill and grace.
